checklist_items.description: Check all the pneumatic pipe lines, Regulators & Pneumatic valves for leakage
Clean the elevating magnetic conveyor belt free of all crowns dust and other foreign matter
Grease the all centerlised grease points - Central lubrication as per the schedule
Check the lift cylinder air pressure & Co2 counter pressure leakages
Check the alignment of guide plates of Air conveyor
Check the bottle movement at air conveyor & supporting guides
Remove all the bottles pieces & clean with water jet
Check the condition of snifts
Check the condition of vent tubes, spreaders and bottle seals, replace if necessary
Drain the condensate and fill the oiler if oil levels is low for smooth movement of pneu cylinders
Check for any jumping movement in the discharge conveyor chain
Check the alignment of the belts
Check for the tension of the belts and adjust if required
Clean the can travelling track from glass and crowns
Check all gear boxes for sound and heating
Clean the case conveyor from debris
Clean all the sensor and proximities for proper functioning
Check the main line water pressure
Check for the unusual sound from pumps
Inspect the alignment of spray nozzle & jettings of all compartments
Check the functioning of the pneumatic modulation valves
Check for the level balance in Syrup reservoir tank
Check the sight glass and pipe lines for leakage
Check the leakages from mechanical seals of mixing pump and CIP booster pump vaccum pump
Clean the all external surfaces of the equipment for vibration
Check all pumps for leakage from the unions and for vibration
Check for any leakage of CO2 and air
Check for the pressure and temperature indicators of the areas
Check for vibrations, sound and gear box heating of all conveyors
Remove all foreign materials from conveyors
Check the movement of the conveyors
Clean the conveyor tracks, remove the cullet if found
Check for the lubrication availability on the chain
Inspect for adequacy of lubrication
Check wear strips of rails for damage, replace them if required
Check the smooth movement of bottles through bottle inspection stations
Check the oil level for conveyor motor if visible
Check the Ink and Make up level
Check & ensure the encoder mounting
Check phocell for proper sensing of the bottles
Check and clean the Electrode plates
Check the product sensor is sensing
Check the product date and expiry date
Check the printings properly done on the products
Check functioning of load / unload solenoid valves
Check functioning of float valve
Check oil leakages at compressor shaft seals
Check cold well & hot well levels
Check all the compressors are ON
Check the temperature level on the screen
Check for Glycol leakage in the system
Check for abnormal sound in pumps & motors
Check sugar dissolving pumps for leakage
Check syrup transfer pumps for leakage
Check Butterfly Valves for leakage
Check Syrup transfer pumps for proper functioning
Check any unusual sound from propellers or motor
Is there any unusual sound coming from machine
Check the filter OK to run production
Check the water flow meter working condition
Check for the leakages from the valves and pump seals
Check syrup transfer pump performance
Check valves condition on syrup tranfer pumps
Check pressure/temp guages
Check the TDS with the help of Lab chemist
Clean flame sensors & viewing glass
Carry out blow down based on TDS value
Check for any steam leakages
Do external cleaning of the boiler
Check the water level in the reservoir tank
Check the reservoir tank float less valve functioning
Check the air intake vaccum indicator
Check the Oil level
Check the condensate discharged from moisture separator during loading
Check unloading and loading pressure
Check air drier functioning and on
Drain out all the filter outlets to drain moisture & water
Is there any unusual sound coming from machine
Check the joint leaking
